metadata.description: Claybot's curated agents — Development, Productivity, Monitoring, Deployment, Automation — installable into Claude Code on their own.

plugins.name: pr-reviewer
plugins.description: Reviews pull requests in five passes (repository rules, bugs, history, past reviews, code comments), scores each finding, and reports only those it is at least 80% confident in, with permalinks.

plugins.name: issue-triager
plugins.description: Classifies new issues and bug severity, searches for duplicates three ways, asks for only what is missing, and suggests the repository's own labels.

plugins.name: test-writer
plugins.description: Writes the tests a pull request is missing, runs them, and opens a pull request with only the tests.

plugins.name: docs-keeper
plugins.description: After each merge, finds the docs the change made wrong and opens a pull request that fixes them.

plugins.name: chat-helper
plugins.description: A chat teammate: short answers formatted for Slack, Discord, or Telegram, research reported with sources, and clean hand-offs to people.

plugins.name: meeting-notes
plugins.description: Turns a transcript or rough notes into decisions, owners and open questions, and remembers them.

plugins.name: research-assistant
plugins.description: Researches a question across primary sources and replies with a short, cited brief.

plugins.name: writing-editor
plugins.description: Edits a draft for clarity and tone, returns the revision, and says what changed and why.

plugins.name: alert-triager
plugins.description: Reads each PagerDuty, Datadog or Grafana alert, ties it to what changed, and says how bad it is and what to check first.

plugins.name: error-investigator
plugins.description: For each new Sentry error, finds the code and the change behind it and proposes a fix.

plugins.name: uptime-watcher
plugins.description: Checks your URLs every 15 minutes and speaks up only when one goes down, slows down, or recovers.

plugins.name: incident-scribe
plugins.description: Keeps the timeline during an incident, answers "where are we?", and drafts the blameless postmortem.

plugins.name: release-notes
plugins.description: Drafts release notes from everything merged since the last tag, grouped and written for users.

plugins.name: release-manager
plugins.description: Walks a release through its checklist, gets your sign-off on a card, then tags it and publishes the notes.

plugins.name: deploy-config-reviewer
plugins.description: Reviews pull requests that touch Dockerfiles, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform or CI for security, reliability and cost risks.

plugins.name: migration-checker
plugins.description: Reviews database migrations in pull requests for locks, downtime, data loss and missing rollbacks.

plugins.name: cloudflare-sdlc-expert
plugins.description: Builds, tests and ships Cloudflare Workers with the cf CLI: cloudflare.config.ts bindings, Wrangler migrations, a preview and check on every pull request, and production deploys only after sign-off.

plugins.name: repo-digest
plugins.description: A de-noised digest of what merged on a branch since the last one, grouped by impact, with migrations, config, CI, and dependency risks called out.

plugins.name: weekly-report
plugins.description: Every Monday, a one-screen report of last week across your repositories — shipped, stuck, and what needs a decision.

plugins.name: stale-sweeper
plugins.description: Each day, nudges issues and pull requests that went quiet, and lists the ones ready to close.

plugins.name: dependency-watch
plugins.description: Every week, checks your repositories for outdated and vulnerable dependencies and keeps one tracking issue up to date.
